motion_blueprints: Typebar Kinetic Arc Strike: When a key is pressed, steel typebar launches from rest at 45° angle, accelerates over 28ms to strike platen at 90°, bounces back with 15ms damped spring recoil.
Carriage Escapement Step: Cylindrical platen steps precisely 1 pitch unit (10.5px) to the left on key release with 12ms metallic ratchet latch and subtle mechanical shudder.

Carriage Return Sweep: When carriage return lever is pulled, the entire platen slides smoothly back to column 0 with accelerating velocity, accompanied by a rapid multi-tooth zip ratchet sound and 1-line vertical paper feed.
